search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: The exact search query string submitted to Google to produce this result set.

results_page.title: Results Page
results_page.description: The page number of Google search results (1 = positions 1–10, 2 = positions 11–20, etc.).

total_results_count.title: Total Results Count
total_results_count.description: Google's estimated count of total results for this query (e.g. 'About 2,450,000,000 results (0.38 seconds)'). May be null if not shown on the page.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (gl parameter) used to query this regional Google index.

language_code.title: Language Code
language_code.description: The BCP-47 language code (hl parameter) used for Google's interface and results language bias.

organic_results.title: Organic Results
organic_results.description: Array of non-paid organic search results. Each item: position (integer), title (string|null), url (string|null), display_url (string|null), description (string|null), date (string|null), sitelinks (array|null), emphasized_keywords (string[]|null).

example.title: 10 Best Project Management Software in 2025
example.description: Compare the top project management tools including Asana, Monday.com, Jira, and Trello...

featured_snippet.title: Featured Snippet
featured_snippet.description: The featured snippet (answer box / Position 0) when present. Contains: title (string|null), description (string|null), url (string|null). Null if no featured snippet on this SERP.

example.title: What is project management software?
example.description: Project management software is a tool that helps teams plan, organize, and manage tasks...

people_also_ask.title: People Also Ask
people_also_ask.description: Array of related questions from the 'People Also Ask' section. Useful for FAQ content, topic ideation, and search intent analysis. Empty array if section not present.
example: What is the best free project management tool?
What do project managers use to manage tasks?

related_searches.title: Related Searches
related_searches.description: Array of related search suggestions shown at the bottom of the SERP. Excellent for keyword research, competitor discovery, and topic clustering. Empty array if not present.

knowledge_graph.title: Knowledge Graph
knowledge_graph.description: Entity Knowledge Graph panel when present. Contains: title (string|null), type (string|null), description (string|null), website (string|null). Null if no Knowledge Graph panel on this SERP.

example.title: Asana
example.description: Asana is a web and mobile work management platform designed to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.

ad_results.title: Ad Results
ad_results.description: Paid advertisement results (Google Ads) found on the page. Each item: title (string|null), url (string|null), description (string|null), display_url (string|null). Empty array if no ads found or includeAds is disabled.

example.title: Top PM Software — Try Free Today
example.description: Manage projects easily with real-time dashboards. 30-day free trial.

search_type.title: Search Type
search_type.description: The type of Google search performed. Currently always 'web' for standard Google web search results.

scraped_at.title: Scraped At
scraped_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this SERP page was scraped. Useful for tracking result freshness.

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: The exact Google Search URL that was scraped to produce this result. Can be used to replicate the search.
